fields.label: Public site origin
fields.appStoreUse: Support URL, Privacy Policy URL, Marketing URL, Accessibility URL
fields.validation: HTTPS URL origin with no placeholder value
fields.nextAction: Publish the generated support/privacy site and set CODY_SITE_URL to that HTTPS origin.

fields.label: Public support email
fields.appStoreUse: Support page, privacy policy, TestFlight feedback email
fields.nextAction: Set the support inbox that should appear publicly on support/privacy pages.

fields.label: App Review contact name
fields.appStoreUse: App Store Connect App Review Information
fields.nextAction: Set the person Apple should contact if review needs clarification.

fields.label: App Review contact email
fields.appStoreUse: App Store Connect App Review Information
fields.example: private App Review contact email address
fields.nextAction: Set the private App Review contact email; it will be redacted in generated release artifacts.

fields.label: App Review contact phone
fields.appStoreUse: App Store Connect App Review Information
fields.validation: Phone number Apple can call during review
fields.nextAction: Set the private App Review phone number; it will be redacted in generated release artifacts.

relatedBlockers.label: CODY_SITE_URL is a real HTTPS URL
relatedBlockers.action: Set CODY_SITE_URL to the final public site origin, then rebuild the site, archive, packet, and manifest.

relatedBlockers.label: CODY_SUPPORT_EMAIL is real
relatedBlockers.action: Set CODY_SUPPORT_EMAIL to the public support contact that will appear on support/privacy pages.

relatedBlockers.label: App Review contact name is real
relatedBlockers.action: Set CODY_REVIEW_CONTACT_NAME for App Store Connect App Review contact information.

relatedBlockers.label: App Review contact email is real
relatedBlockers.action: Set CODY_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL for App Store Connect App Review contact information.

relatedBlockers.label: App Review contact phone is real
relatedBlockers.action: Set CODY_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE for App Store Connect App Review contact information.

relatedBlockers.label: Generated App Store fields have HTTPS support/privacy URLs
relatedBlockers.action: Run npm run packet:store after real CODY_SITE_URL is available.
